title: Reciprocal-rank fusion
text: Reciprocal-rank fusion adds 1 divided by the RRF constant plus the one-based rank for every ranked list containing a chunk.

title: Why rank fusion
text: RRF combines lexical and vector lists without calibrating their incompatible raw scores, but it discards score magnitude.

title: Stable chunks
text: A chunk identifier stays stable for unchanged content under the same chunking version. A chunking change requires re-indexing and evaluation.

title: Readiness
text: The readiness endpoint checks PostgreSQL and Redis dependencies. Liveness only confirms that the API process can respond.

title: Request correlation
text: Clients can send an X-Request-ID header. The service returns the request ID so API calls, structured logs, and traces can be correlated.

title: Safe metrics
text: Prometheus metrics use bounded labels. Workspace, document, query, request, and job identifiers stay out of metric labels to control cardinality.

title: Asynchronous ingestion
text: Document submission creates a pending ingestion job. A worker chunks and embeds the content before transactionally publishing searchable chunks.

title: Ingestion retries
text: Queue delivery can repeat, so ingestion processing and finalization must be idempotent. Clients poll the job until it succeeds or fails.

title: Citation validation
text: Generated citations are accepted only when they identify chunks supplied as answer context and owned by the same workspace.

title: Workspace isolation
text: Every document and chunk query applies the workspace predicate in the database operation rather than filtering results afterward.

title: Local providers
text: Deterministic local embedding, reranking, and generation providers keep tests and the default demonstration repeatable and free of external model keys.

title: System of record
text: PostgreSQL is the durable system of record for documents, chunks, jobs, and traces. Redis carries reconstructable queue and cache state.
